messages.en:
{07 14 00}Mornin',{01 00 00 05 00} {04 1f 00}!{01 00 00 14 00} {07 00 00}It was
snowing when I woke up this
morning! Yaaaaaay!
{07 14 00}I was so happy!{01 01 00} {07 13 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}It means
today is all-you-can-eat
snow cone day, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Hommikust,{01 00 00 05 00} {04 1f 00}!{01 00 00 14 00} {07 00 00}Kui
täna ärkasin, sadas
lund! Jeeee!
{07 14 00}Olin nii õnnelik!{01 01 00} {07 13 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Täna
saab lumekoonuseid süüa
kõhu täis,{01 00 00 0a 00} {04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 12 00}YAWWWN.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 14 00} Mornin'.{01 00 00 0a 00} Snow days
sure are cold, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}.
{01 00 00 0a 00}{07 07 00}Brrrrrr!
{07 1b 00}{01 00 00 05 00}Do you think this is how
ice cream feels all the
time? {01 00 00 05 00}Poor ice cream...

{0b 03 00}{01 06 00}Hey{01 07 00}.{01 00 00 0f 00}{07 14 00} I was
thinking. {01 01 00}{07 0e 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}You know how you
leave prints in the snow?
{07 14 00}Do you think the police use
them to find bad guys,{01 00 00 0a 00}
{04 02 00}?
messages.et:
{0b 03 00}{01 06 00}Hei{01 07 00}.{01 00 00 0f 00}{07 14 00} Ma
mõtlesin. {01 01 00}{07 0e 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Tead ju, kuidas
lumme jäävad jäljed?
{07 14 00}Kas arvad, et politsei leiab
nende järgi pahalasi,{01 00 00 0a 00}
{04 02 00}?

messages.en:
{07 14 00}{0b 03 00}{01 06 00}Good evening{01 07 00}. {01 00 00 14 00}{07 00 00}
So, were you gone all day,
{04 1f 00},{01 00 00 05 00} or what?
{07 16 00}'Cause I wanted to make
snowmen with you, but you
weren't around!!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}{0b 03 00}{01 06 00}Tere õhtust{01 07 00}. {01 00 00 14 00}{07 00 00}
Kas sa olid terve päeva
ära, {04 1f 00},{01 00 00 05 00} või?
{07 16 00}Sest ma tahtsin sinuga
lumememmesid teha, aga
sind polnud kuskil!!

messages.en:
{07 04 00}Oh! {01 00 00 0a 00}Wow! It's already
{04 08 00} o'clock!{01 01 00} {07 00 00}I played in the
snow all day!
{07 14 00}It sure would be fun if
it snowed all year long,{01 00 00 0a 00}
{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 04 00}Oh! {01 00 00 0a 00}Vau! Kell on juba
{04 08 00}!{01 01 00} {07 00 00}Mängisin terve
päeva lumes!
{07 14 00}Oleks ju tore, kui lund
sajaks aasta läbi,{01 00 00 0a 00}
{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}{0b 03 00}{01 06 00}Hey{01 07 00}!
It's {04 1f 00}.{01 00 00 0a 00} Good
evening,{01 00 00 0a 00} {04 02 00}.
{07 0e 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Have you noticed that when
it snows,{01 00 00 0a 00} everybody's roof
turns white?
{07 14 00}{01 00 00 05 00}So, {01 00 00 0a 00}in places where it snows
a lot,{01 00 00 0a 00} people can't switch
their roof color, huh.
messages.et:
{07 14 00}{0b 03 00}{01 06 00}Hei{01 07 00}!
Sina oled {04 1f 00}.{01 00 00 0a 00} Tere
õhtust,{01 00 00 0a 00} {04 02 00}.
{07 0e 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Kas oled märganud, et kui
sajab lund,{01 00 00 0a 00} lähevad kõigi
katused valgeks?
{07 14 00}{01 00 00 05 00}Nii et {01 00 00 0a 00}seal, kus sajab
palju lund,{01 00 00 0a 00} ei saa katuse
värvi vahetada, mis.

messages.en:
{07 14 00}{0b 03 00}{01 06 00}Hi{01 07 00}!{01 00 00 14 00} Are you
also out late playing in the
snow?
{07 1b 00}I thought so.{01 01 00} {07 13 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Nighttime in
the snow{01 00 00 05 00} is so quiet it's
like another world.
messages.et:
{07 14 00}{0b 03 00}{01 06 00}Tsau{01 07 00}!{01 00 00 14 00} Kas sinagi
oled hilja väljas lumes
mängimas?
{07 1b 00}Nii ma arvasingi.{01 01 00} {07 13 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Öö
lumes{01 00 00 05 00} on nii vaikne, nagu
oleks teine maailm.
